data.title: 紫藤伊莉娜 · 烛光床畔纯白吊带的虔诚心绪
data.description: 静谧夜室里烛火摇曳，伊莉娜跪坐于床垫边缘，纯白蕾丝吊带勾勒柔软身段，十字架项链垂落锁骨，双颊绯红眼眸湿润。
data.action: 双膝并拢跪坐床边，双手交叠于心口，十字架坠入胸前，纯情而毫无保留地凝望
data.lighting: 暖橙色摇曳烛火与柔和壁灯，在白皙肌肤上泛起诱人暖晕
data.camera: 近景正面微俯视，凸显清纯与诱惑交织的强烈张力
data.promptProse: 1girl, solo, irina shidou, brown hair, twin tails draped forward, amber eyes, pure white lace saint camisole, thin spaghetti straps, delicate cross necklace hanging against bare chest, kneeling gently on plush bed sheets, hands clasped over heart, blushing deeply with moist eyes, warm flickering candlelight ambiance, intimate quiet room.
